subject: MATHEMATICS
applicability_conditions: learner must interpret (x,y) roles in coordinate tasks
use before slope/collinearity teaching when coordinate-role evidence is unknown or unstable
anchor: An ordered pair has roles: the first coordinate is horizontal x and the second is vertical y; swapping roles changes the point.
ordinary_language_bridge: Read (x,y) as horizontal first, vertical second; the order is part of the meaning.
reconstruction_route: locate first coordinate on horizontal axis
locate second coordinate on vertical axis
pair like roles when forming differences

minimal_contrast.prediction_prompt: Do these name the same point? What changes?

misconception_discriminator.probe: ask learner to plot or verbally locate two swapped pairs
misconception_discriminator.decisive_response: learner distinguishes the points and preserves x/y roles

repair_route: label coordinates before any slope formula
use a slope triangle tied to coordinate differences
verification_method: plot or mentally locate the point
check that x-differences use first coordinates and y-differences use second coordinates
known_limitations: does not establish slope sign rules by itself
